bonus_crossover_status.rule: first target size with method mean at least 0.01 above fixed best-TF-IDF mean

bonus_learning_curves.rule: fixed Part 1 TF-IDF model per target/size; mean and sample SD across aligned seeds

bonus_representation.rule: mean over three seeds, then mean and SD across four target-label sizes

bonus_transfer.rule: method mean minus matched pooled-CE mean; labels are target-label counts

confusion_comparison.rule: sum three seed confusion counts, then normalize within actual class

dataset_overview.rule: count labels by dataset and fixed split

efficiency_pareto.rule: mean across three seeds; outlined points are non-dominated on quality versus fit time

full_data_comparison.rule: full-data mean and sample SD across three final seeds

part1_crossover.rule: best complete neural mean minus best complete TF-IDF mean at each size

part1_learning_curves.rule: mean with sample-SD error bars across three final seeds
